scope_policy: Track the remaining fixed engineering outcomes. Source-inventory coverage, isolated SPICE parity and release version numbers do not substitute for receiver or repair validation.

actions.evidence_dependency: Existing drawings may suffice; clearer source/chassis evidence only if the unresolved details remain ambiguous.
acceptance: Assign both 7C6 diode glyphs to socket pins 5/6.
Resolve the four-dot oscillator coupling symbol and complete its electrical representation.
Resolve #8 0.05/0.1 µF value conflict or retain a specifically approved variant.
actions.v055_review: Manufacturer basing identifies the two separate 7C6 diodes, but does not assign the unnumbered Philco glyphs to physical pins. No source-backed assignment or oscillator/#8 resolution is claimed.

actions.evidence_dependency: Manufacturer data, derivation and sensitivity work are actionable; some exact parameters need measurements or parts data.
acceptance: Validate models for all five tube types against manufacturer curves.
Establish coil/transformer L, coupling, winding resistance and output-transformer/speaker relationship.
Establish volume-control resistance/taper, field inductance and lamp/heater behavior; identify supported approximations.
completed_in_v055: Approximate manufacturer-derived 7C6 and 50L6 curve tables with typical-point/slope and separate graph checks.
Explicit transformer/volume/grid-current assumptions and transformer sensitivity scenario.
remaining_after_v055: Validate denser audio curves, grid-current and screen-scaling behavior.
Complete 7A8/7B7/35Z3 models and coil/transformer/pot/lamp/heater parameter validation.
completed_in_v056: Declare detector/source/volume parameters and compare both unresolved #8 values; no diode-curve or IF-winding calibration claimed.

actions.action: Connect power supply to receiver loads
actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable with existing sources and models.
acceptance: Replace power-bench stand-in resistors with currents drawn by the actual receiver stages.
Validate rectifier conduction and heater/lamp behavior over supported supply conditions.
Check reservoir/filtered voltages, ripple, startup and discharge under healthy and faulty receiver loads.
completed_in_v055: Jointly solve audio plate/screen currents with the dynamic supply; no one-way rail feed.
Exercise healthy, coupling leakage, dead output, dry filter and field-open behavior.
remaining_after_v055: Replace the remaining RF/IF substitute demand with actual converter/IF stage currents.
Validate rectifier, heater, lamp and field behavior across supported line conditions.

actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable with existing topology and manufacturer data; uncertain transformer/speaker values need bounded parameters.
acceptance: Model volume control, 7C6 triode, 50L6 output stage and output transformer/speaker.
Validate gain, bias, clipping, loading and hum transfer; make output respond to component faults.
completed_in_v055: Implement volume, 7C6 triode, 50L6, winding DCR/magnetizing L and reflected speaker load.
Exercise gain, bias, clipping, hum, mute, coupling faults and restoration under declared parameters.
remaining_after_v055: Correlate uncertain transformer/speaker, volume and grid-current parameters; validate frequency response and a broader operating envelope.
Connect audio behavior and faults to the shop receiver/inventory/jobs.

actions.action: Complete IF, detector and AVC behavior
actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable in parallel with remaining diode pin mapping.
acceptance: Model 455 kHz IF transfer, bandwidth, tuned adjustments and stage loading.
Implement detector rectification, audio recovery and AVC attack/release/loading.
Verify responses to signal strength, misalignment and component faults.
completed_in_v056: Carrier-resolved two-diode detector/AVC subset with factory-traced #7/#8/#15/#17/#18/#19 and volume network.
AM audio recovery, AVC arrival/release, fault/restoration and selectable #8 sensitivity cases under declared diode/source assumptions.
remaining_after_v056: Active 7B7 stage, coupled/tuned IF windings, 455 kHz bandwidth/alignment and actual supply load.
AVC feedback to converter/IF gain; correlate diode/source parameters, grid loading and steady-state/long-duration behavior.
Join detector, nonlinear audio and supply in one loaded receiver model.

actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable after the coupling symbol is resolved; additional schematics are not a general prerequisite.
acceptance: Implement oscillator/converter behavior and tracking across 540–1600 kHz.
Validate the 455 kHz frequency relationship, tuning/alignment effects and input behavior.
Check weak/dead oscillator and aerial faults against the receiver model.

actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable by defining repeatable model test conditions; historical conditions may require additional evidence.
acceptance: Connect meters, signal generator and tracer to authoritative receiver nodes with defined loading.
Record supply, control settings, signal and instrument conditions for each benchmark measurement.
Use historical voltage labels only where return/loading/conditions support comparison; distinguish simulated reference conditions.
completed_in_v055: Connect ideal, 10 MΩ/100 pF and 1000 Ω/V (250 V range) probes to explicit audio/power nodes.
Record supply, signal, volume, timing and instrument conditions; keep factory targets separate.
remaining_after_v055: Extend node access/loading to RF/IF/detector/AVC and shop instruments.
Verify historical measurement conditions where factory targets are used.
completed_in_v056: Five detector/AVC probe ports with ideal, 10 MΩ/100 pF and 1000 Ω/V (10 V range) loading; declared signal/timing/reference conditions.

actions.evidence_dependency: Existing layout/photos support most work; exact hidden physical routes may need better photos or continuity.
acceptance: Map component endpoints and instrument access to the serviceable game chassis.
Resolve physical identities that affect faults, polarity or repairs.
Keep unsupported lead dress and chassis/B− bond claims explicit.

actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable after receiver stages and instruments are integrated.
acceptance: Establish a deterministic healthy-radio baseline over supported tuning/supply conditions.
Exercise a fixed fault matrix through diagnosis, part replacement, alignment and successful checkout.
Run regressions, record limitations and close the six agreed benchmark gates only when their acceptance evidence is met.
completed_in_v055: Deterministic audio/power healthy baseline and fault/restoration scenarios.
remaining_after_v055: Integrate full receiver stages and shop repair workflow.
Run the full diagnosis/replacement/alignment/checkout matrix and close all six gates.
completed_in_v056: Deterministic detector/AVC fault/restoration cases; full shop acceptance remains open.

next_integration_target: EC-05/03: active IF stage, tuned transformer loading and actual supply current; AVC gain feedback.
EC-05/04: join detector with the nonlinear audio/supply model, preserving mutual loading.
EC-02/06: correlate tube/winding parameters and implement RF/converter tracking.
EC-07/08/09: chassis/instrument/shop integration and complete repair acceptance.
milestone_completed: v0.56 adds a carrier-resolved detector/AVC subset, audio recovery and AVC arrival/release, loaded probes, unresolved #8 variant controls and fault/restoration tests. The IF source and diode law are explicit assumptions; active IF, AVC feedback, full receiver/supply coupling and shop integration remain open.
